full_judgment: 10. It is further stated that, one Md Fazlu Miah and others and Md Kamruzzaman and others, standing on similar footing like the petitioners, already moved two writ petitions, namely Writ Petition No. 789 of 1996 and Writ Petition No. 1727 of 1966, before the High Court Division, whereupon a Division Bench comprising Mr Justice Md Rezaul Haque and Mr Justice Muhammad Khurshid Alam Sarkar, vide judgments and order dated 24-5-2016 and 1-6-2016 respectively, discharged the Rules thereby holding that the said writ petitions were not maintainable as the petitioners were government servants. It is also stated that, one Md Nazrul Islam and others also filed Writ Petition No. 1725 of 1996 on similar issues, whereupon a Division Bench of this Court comprising of Mr Justice Shahidul Islam and Ms Justice Syeda Afsar Jahan, vide order dated 7-1-2010, discharged the Rule for default. It is stated that, petitioner Nos. 1 and 2 also filed Writ Petition No. 4666 of 2003 on the same cause and the Rule issued in the said writ petition was discharged on the ground that the petitioners filed a forged document being memo dated 18-9-2002 (Annexure-I to the said writ petition), claiming the same to have been issued by the Prime Minister's Office, in order to reinstate them. Not only that, it is stated, the High Court Division in the said writ petition, vide judgment and order dated 14-7-2004, directed the Registry of the Supreme Court to file criminal case against the said petitioners for such forgery, whereupon a Criminal Case, being Petition Case No. 330 of 2005, was filed against the petitioner Nos. 1 and 2 before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Dhaka under sections 468/471 of the Penal Code., However, the said petitioners were finally acquitted vide judgment dated 26.06.2013. It is further contended by this respondent that, one Sher Ali, (added petitioner No.9), as convener of the ১৯৯৪ সনে আনসার অধিদপ্তরের ২৪৯৬ জন চাকুরীচ্যুত আনসার ব্যাটালিয়ন কর্মচারীর চাকুরীতে পুঃবহাল বাস্তবায়ন কমিটি, filed Title Suit No. 529 of 2009 before the 4th Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka seeking almost same relief as sought in this writ petition and the plaint of the said suit was rejected vide order dated 13-7-2010 on the ground that the case of the petitioners would lie before the Administrative Tribunal as they were govern-ment servants. That the present petitioner Nos. 9, being convener of “১৯৯৪ সনের চাকুরীচ্যুত ব্যাটালিয়ন আনসারদের পুনর্বহাল বাস্তবায়ন কমিটি” also made representation to the Hon`ble President for their reinstatement, whereupon the Office of the Hon'ble President, vide memo dated 20-1-2010, forwarded the said representation to the Ministry of Home Affairs to take appropriate steps. Thereupon, the Ministry of Home Affairs forwarded the same to DG Ansar. The DG Ansar then, vide letter dated 31-3-2010, informed the ministry that the post of Ansars before 1994 were not regarded as permanent posts and, as such, after their disembodiment, there was no scope for reinstatement to their services. It is also stated that, the petitioners have come up with the instant writ petition seeking almost same relief after twenty years of their disembodiment in particular when most of the petitioners have in the meantime become unfit for their services in the Ansar battalion and that some of them have already crossed the age limit for such service. It is stated that, only 234 petitioners were included in the list of 2496 disembodied battalion ansars and, as such, the remaining 55 petitioners, particularly petitioner Nos. 2, 6, 13, 17, 24, 25, 28, 30, 32, 48, 54, 57, 61, 62, 63, 65, 67, 71, 72, 76, 80, 86, 87, 88, 113, 116, 127, 142, 144, 148, 149, 153, 165, 172, 181, 185, 190, 192, 201, 211, 222, 223, 225, 238, 242, 252, 253, 254, 255, 269, 270, 274, 281, 283 and 284, were not included in the list of disembodied ansar members and hence the said 55 petitioners have been added in the instant writ petition without their supporting service related documents just to take undue advantage from the outcome of this writ petition by practicing fraud upon this Court. It is also stated that, the petitioner Nos. 58 and 271 have been convicted and sentenced in absentia for their involvement in the mutiny vide judgment and order dated 5-4-2000 in Sarsha Police Station Case No. 28 dated 20-12-1994 corresponding to GR Case No. 1562 of 1994 under section 114(Ka), 353/283 of the Penal Code. Hence, it is stated, the said petitioner Nos. 58 and 271, being fugitive, cannot file writ petition before this Court.
